Without the code I don't know what the two games are, what languages or engines they use, or how their folders are laid out. Writing stack specs would mean guessing all of that. It would also break the spec's own rule that the trees are built in the game's existing language and renderer.

I also held off on moving the tree spec into a per-game folder. Where the guidance file lands in the code depends on the game's real folder name. If I guess `rally/` and the code calls it something else, it ends up in the wrong place.
